verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an AI app builder, but no evidence item documents a bulk or batch capability, such as acting on many projects, files, or records in one operation. Workspace-wide skills, the SQL editor, the MCP server and the versioned API are adjacent features or building blocks, not a documented bulk-operations capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
